thread:
anya: Quick sync — we need to agree on the launch criteria and hard constraints for the new Starter+ bundle before we go to PM review. TL;DR: tier limits, add-on scoping, and contract guardrails.

mike_p: +1. Can we list the must-have launch requirements? I'll own the PRD once we agree.

sophia_sales: Customers keep asking for modest committed spend + cheap burst credits. Also a per-seat vs metered debate for SMBs.

kevin_eng: Implementation caveats: quota enforcement, metering, and billing hooks are the big work. Metering requires us to ship token-level attribution and a webhook for usage events. ETA depends on schema finalization.

raj_fin: From revenue modeling — Starter+ needs a minimum committed mrr to justify reserved capacity. Suggested options: (A) $2k/mo commit with 2x burst pool, or (B) no commit but a per-token uplift. Both have margin tradeoffs.

emily_legal: Contract notes: if we include burst credits we must define expiration, non-transferability, and clear overage terms. Also flag: data residency & audit logs for any customer requesting Private later.

mike_p: Proposed launch checklist (draft):
- Product SKU + public doc for limits (requests/min, tokens/day)
- Billing wiring for committed vs on-demand pricing
- Add-on: burst credits (configurable, expiration)
- Add-on: priority routing (for Dedicated tiers only)
- Launch acceptance criteria: 95th p99 latency under 300ms for common prompt shapes; billing events delivered <60s; test customer (pilot) signed

anya: Quick techn spec suggestion for limits: ``limits: {requests_per_minute: 1200, concurrent_streams: 10, daily_tokens: 2_000_000}`` — these are placeholders but help engineering estimate.

kevin_eng: Those numbers are reasonable as starting defaults. Important: quota enforcement must be configurable per-customer and per-route. That adds ~3 sprint work if we reuse the existing quota service. If not, it's 5+.

sophia_sales: For sales packaging: make burst credits purchasable as an add-on and include a pilot coupon so early customers don't hit immediate soft caps. Also, allow seat addons for plugins/integrations.

raj_fin: Also ask for a simulated P&L on both commit and uplift pricing. If commit is too high, we cannibalize SMB uptake. Model should include expected utilization (30-60%) and churn sensitivity.

emily_legal: We need a short contract clause for burst credits: "Unused burst credits expire 90 days after issuance; Redwood reserves the right to limit burst usage subject to capacity constraints; burst credits are not refundable."

mike_p: Can someone from infra confirm telemetry + billing webhook SLA? @kevin_eng you?

kevin_eng: I can confirm: telemetry pipeline can emit usage events to billing with ~30s typical delay; worst-case 2m under load without dedicated scaling. Webhook delivery retries exist. Need explicit acceptance criteria for launch: 95% of events <60s.

anya: Ops checklist item: create a bleed plan if billing mismatch happens (e.g., temporarily disable burst credits for affected customers). Add on-call playbook.

packaging-bot: ACTIONS CREATED: #1 Mike: finalize PRD draft by Tue EOD; #2 Kevin: run quota-enforcement estimate and confirm sprint count; #3 Raj: p&l scenarios for commit vs uplift by Fri; #4 Sophia: identify 3 pilot customers for pricing test; #5 Emily: draft burst-credit contract clause.

mike_p: I'll put the PRD link once done. Any objections to the limits above or launch criteria?

sophia_sales: No objections. Request: include a promotion window (first 60 days) where we can temporarily raise soft caps for pilots.

emily_legal: Fine with that, but add audit trail requirement for any temporary cap changes.

anya: Great — if no further blockers I'll merge this into the PRD draft and kick off implementation triage. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
